title: Tool Result Undo Report
description: The undo reporting fields the REAPER extension includes in the payload of a response:* envelope for a mutating constrained tool. The extension captures the undo stack position before it applies its change and reports it as undoPositionBefore; the MCP Tool Server records that value as the agent turn's undo position marker so the chat UI can offer "revert all AI changes" (ADR-0015). Tools that leave the undo stack untouched omit both fields. Tool-specific result fields sit alongside these, which is why additional properties are allowed.

undoPositionBefore.description: REAPER undo stack position captured by the extension immediately before this tool applied its change. A "revert all AI changes" operation calls Undo_DoUndo2 in a loop until the stack is back at this position.

undoDescription.description: Undo point description the extension passed to Undo_EndBlock2 for this tool, persisted with the tool_result message so the chat UI can list what the agent changed.
